review.imagery: Twenty-one own-project renders cover the tower, leisure deck, roof, children’s area, lobby and home interiors. All 26 native brochure resources and six current primary gallery images were visually reviewed. Generic family, technology, cooking, party, pool-jumping and rooftop-runner photographs are excluded. The native full-tower view on physical page 2 supplies the card and hero with top alignment. Proposed finishes and views remain unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: Four complete official home drawings show studios with and without a pool, plus 1 BR and 2 BR pool homes. A separate branded Petkovic broker-hosted PDF adds the complete second-to-sixteenth-floor overview. The 1 BR drawing labels a store. Numerical unit areas and approved numbered-unit matching are not printed on these sheets. Confirm the contractual configuration, area definition and pool provision with SAMANA. All four complete original home sheets 32–35 and the broker mirror’s complete physical page 2 were visually reviewed. The exact second-to-sixteenth-floor grouping remains intact. No numerical home area is inferred from portal ranges or the coloured floorplate. Original branding, legends and physical PDF-page links are preserved.
review.location: Complete original connectivity pages 9–10 were visually reviewed. The full regional schematic retains its original transport context and explicit operating-service limitation. All ten published travel entries agree with the current primary. The unnamed airport remains explicit source wording. The name-only primary map query is recorded with HTML hash. No coordinate, direct station access or live route is inferred.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, official brochure bytes, native image origins and the public Petkovic floor-plan PDF retain source receipts and hashes. The supplementary document remains labeled as a broker mirror. No contact/download form was submitted. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific unit areas, approved unit matching, the exact airport/terminal behind the source wording, operating transport details at the plot, precise visitor entrance coordinates, final unit fitout/views and dated construction photographs were not established.
